title: Tecsys TS8200 Digital Media Converter
excerpt: Media Converter for digital signals in H.264 standard in HD / SD or MPEG-2 standard in SD, for professional use for digital terrestrial or satellite TV DVB-S / S2, Remultiplexation Lite RMX or RMA, with features, performance and reliability compatible with international standards.
body:
Media Converter for digital signals in H.264 standard in HD / SD or MPEG-2 standard in SD, for professional use for digital terrestrial or satellite TV DVB-S / S2, Remultiplexation Lite RMX or RMA, with features, performance and reliability compatible with international standards.

Main Features:

REMOTE CONTROL – Remote control tuning via satellite commands (optional)

TSoIP – Allows you to play a TS received over the Ethernet network

T-CRYPT – Subscriber management system that allows you to enable / block ID's (optional)

CAM – Conditional Access Module compatible with EN 50221-1997 (available only for DVB-S / S2 model)

WEB INTERFACE – Allows complete management of the converter through its web interface

USB Interface for Firmware Upgrade

Decodes Closed Caption ATSC and ISDB-Tb formats

Customization of the splash screen of the equipment

Remultiplexing (Optional)

RMX – Creates a BTS stream (204 bytes) from internally generated (SI / PSI) tables Used in the satellite signal descent for ISDB-T local generation and does not support SFN

RMA – Regenerates a BTS stream from a stream prepared by a compressor in the uplink

Allows change of area code, virtual and physical channel

Used in satellite signal descent for ISDB-T local generation and supports SFN

Video format: MPEG-4 – AVC (HD)

Profile: MP @ L4, HP @ L4

Video Rate (Max): 20 Mbps

Video format: 1080i@59.94Hz, 720p@59.94Hz

MPEG-4 – AVC (SD)

Profile: MP @ L3

Video Rate (Max): 10 Mbps

MPEG-2 – AVC (HD)

Profile: MP @ HL

Video Rate (Max): 72 Mbps (MP @ HL)

Video format: 1080i@59.94Hz, 720p@29.97Hz

MPEG-2 – AVC (SD)

Profile: MP @ ML

Video Rate (Max): 15 Mbps (MP @ ML)

Video Output

Standard: MPEG-2 / DVB Compatible

Resolution (Max): 720×480 @ 60Hz or 720×576 @ 50Hz

Output system: Pal-M, Pal-N and NTSC-M

Connector: RCA Type – Female

Impedance: 75Ω

Audio Output: MPEG-2 Layer I & II Format

Sampling: 32KHz, 44.1KHz or 48KHz

Modes: Mono, stereo or dual

Channels: 2 (L and R)

Connector: RCA Type – Female

Impedance: 10k?

General features

Cabinet: Standard 19 "- 1 UPB

Power supply: 90 to 242 VAC – automatic

Consumption: 22 Watts

Temp. operating temperature: -10 to + 65 ° C

Altitude (max): 5500m / snm
